name: Last USD
oneLiner: USDXL is Last's synthetic dollar minted as CDP-style debt against blue-chip collateral on HypurrFi (Aave-V3 fork on HyperEVM), with no public redemption rail.
collateral: Position-backed synthetic dollar minted against blue-chip overcollateralized positions on HypurrFi's Aave V3 fork on HyperEVM, with protocol-owned liquidity and stablecoin reserves including USDT0 supporting secondary liquidity. Eligible borrow collateral includes HYPE and HYPE LSTs, bridged BTC, and ETH.
pegMechanism: Users open overcollateralized CDP-style borrows on HypurrFi and mint USDXL against their position; repayment burns the synthetic dollar. Liquidations and protocol-owned liquidity defend the peg, but public docs do not describe an enabled direct 1:1 holder redemption against issuer reserves.

oracleRisk.summary: HypurrFi docs identify Pyth as the primary price-feed source for USDXL markets, with RedStone redundancy and Hyperliquid validator feeds for select assets but no reviewed failover logic.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDXL spans HyperEVM and Hyperliquid, and L2BEAT describes the Hyperliquid bridge as a canonical USDC bridge validated by a permissioned validator set. Pharos reviews the route as external validated-network exposure.

notices.title: HypurrFi market closure deadline
notices.message: HypurrFi announced that Legacy and Pooled markets will wind down and close by July 15, 2026. USDXL borrow rates were raised to 30% to incentivize repayment before closure; users with debt positions should verify repayment and migration routes directly in HypurrFi/Euler tooling.

notices.title: No direct public redemption rail
notices.message: USDXL is minted and repaid through HypurrFi debt positions. Pharos does not model a redemption backstop because public Last/HypurrFi materials reviewed do not expose an enabled direct 1:1 holder redemption route.

mintAuthority.summary: USDXL is a GHO-style CDP synthetic dollar on HypurrFi (an Aave-v3 fork on HyperEVM) in wind-down: pooled new borrows are suspended and settlement targets July 15, 2026. The token's GHO AccessControl roles have no members (facilitator set and bucket caps are frozen); the only remaining mint-relevant control is the 2/2 proxy-admin Safe's upgrade power.

controls.label: HypurrFi USDXL facilitator / borrow contracts (Aave-v3 fork, GHO model; role set frozen)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by overcollateralized borrow positions and GHO-style facilitator bucket capacity within the HypurrFi pooled market. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE on the token have zero members, so facilitators cannot be added/removed and bucket capacities cannot be raised short of a proxy upgrade.
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 37556224: getFacilitatorsList() returned exactly 3 facilitators (0x7911c2…, 0xd12f1c…, 0xcb1710… — HypurrFi market loans, flash loans, USDT0 PSM); hasRole returned false for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE, and BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE across the proxy-admin Safe, all 3 facilitators, the implementation, and HypurrFi governance addresses; no RoleGranted events exist (genesis-deployed contract, role storage empty). mint() reverts FACILITATOR_BUCKET_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (buckets exhausted, wind-down in progress, settlement target July 15 2026).

controls.label: HypurrFi / Last proxy admin Safe (upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: At HyperEVM block 37547570: EIP-1967 proxy admin slot of USDXL (0xca79db4b...) = 0xf050623d...; getOwners() returned [0x67a6d918..., 0xae04ce2f...]; Safe storage slot 3 (ownerCount) = 2, slot 4 (threshold) = 2, slot 5 (guard) = 0; getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). masterCopy = 0xfb1bffc9... This Safe controls USDXL implementation upgrades.

review.evidence: At HyperEVM block 37547570: USDXL proxy (0xca79db4b49f608ef54a5cb813fbed3a6387bc645) EIP-1967 proxy admin = Safe 2/2 (0xf050623d497be7ea6653fd205a537d10300b4c6e); Safe owners [0x67a6d918..., 0xae04ce2f...], threshold=2, no modules, no guard, masterCopy=0xfb1bffc9... At block 37556224 the facilitator-bucket ACL was resolved: getFacilitatorsList() = 3 facilitators (market loans, flash loans, USDT0 PSM) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE / FACILITATOR_MANAGER_ROLE / BUCKET_MANAGER_ROLE) = false for the Safe, all facilitators, the implementation, and HypurrFi governance addresses, with no RoleGranted events in history — the GHO role set has zero members and the facilitator/bucket configuration is frozen. The sole remaining mint-capable authority is the 2/2 proxy-admin Safe via implementation upgrade.
